content_sections.heading: OGEL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 7 vacancies are available – 1 for Finance Officer, 1 for Legal Officer, 2 for Contract and Procurement Officer, 1 for Executive Officer to CEO, 1 for Civil Engineer, and 1 for Company Secretary.

content_sections.heading: OGEL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Finance Officer: CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) with more than 03 years post-qualification experience. Legal Officer: Full-time LLB (3/5 years) with min 60% or LLM with more than 01 year post-qualification experience. Contract and Procurement Officer: Degree in Engineering or Commerce graduate with MBA with 02-03 years post-qualification experience in procurement/contracting. Executive Officer to CEO: Masters (PG) in any discipline with more than 03 years post-qualification experience in data processing. Civil Engineer: B.E / B.Tech in Civil Engineering with more than 03 years post-qualification experience in civil works for process plants. Company Secretary: CS final examination passed, Associate Member of ICSI with more than 03 years post-qualification experience.

content_sections.heading: OGEL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 45 years Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data. Please refer to the official notification for details. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OGEL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the OGEL Various Contractual Officers posts is 12th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in OGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for Various Contractual Officers posts announced by Oil Green Energy (OGEL).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for OGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for these positions by sending their applications via email to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the OGEL posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years for all the posts advertised.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Contractual Officers posts?
faq.answer: The salary for these contractual positions ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for OGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for OGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a screening followed by a personal interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Which educational qualifications are required for the Finance Officer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Finance Officer position, candidates must be a CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) with over 3 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with an LLB degree apply for the Legal Officer post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a full-time LLB (3/5 years) with a minimum of 60% marks or an LLM with over 1 year of post-qualification experience can apply.

faq.question: Q10. What is the experience required for the Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: For the Civil Engineer role, candidates need a B.E / B.Tech in Civil Engineering with more than 3 years of post-qualification experience in civil works for process plants.
